title: Sound Threshold Detector
description: Three rooms, one clap, and a threshold line you can drag until the detector works -- or stops working.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Sensors, Displays, Motors, and Robot Chassis

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a sound waveform and an adjustable threshold, the learner explains how threshold placement determines which sounds register as a trigger and which are ignored.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Drag the threshold line and swap between three background-noise scenarios
pedagogical.assessment: Find the highest and lowest threshold that still works in the noisy room.
